notes.title: Hot Fix - Some Cool Mechanics
notes.content:
[b] Some Cool Imporovement [/b]

[list]
[*] Added ambient sounds to bunkers (also affects voice speech)
[*] you will be able to have a snowball fight on the snowy map (use ice boulders to get the snowball)
[/list]

[b] Bug & Improvement [/b]

[list]
[*]That someone can sell the bicycle when there are others using it (Fixed)
[*]Walkie talkie spam bug (Fixed)
[*]when you die, the settings go back to the background (Fixed)
[*]The scanning sound could be softened a bit (Improved)
[*]the task panel will be reconfigured (Improved)
[*]Wrong item name (Fixed)
[*]Scroll bar for bind setting (Added)
[*]you can't scan or punch when you duck (Fixed)
[*]item monetization in crusher should be made easier (Improved)
[*]Invert mouse setting (Added)
[*]sensitive control with number (Added)
[*]make Decor & fun tab more visible (Improved)
[*]Some font problems (Improved)
[*]Snow bunker missing wall collider (Fixed)
[*]Translation Problems (Improved)
[/list]
